column2: Volt set the scooter's clock right before this test, so the scooter may not be keeping the time it's given. Until that's solved, a smart plug is a safer timer. Report an issue with diagnostics so we can look into it.
column3: Aplikácia Volt nastavila hodiny kolobežky tesne pred týmto testom, takže kolobežka možno nie je schopná udržať nastavený čas. Kým sa to nevyrieši, bezpečnejším časovačom je inteligentná zásuvka. Nahláste problém s diagnostikou, aby sme to mohli preveriť.
column4: The Volt app set the scooter's clock just before this test, so the scooter perhaps is not able to keep the set time. Until this is resolved, a smart plug is a safer timer. Report the problem with diagnostics so that we can investigate it.
